name: Kvaesitso
insteadOf: Pixel Launcher / Nova Launcher / Niagara Launcher
hook: A search-first home screen: swipe down and one lightning-fast bar finds apps, contacts, calendar events, and web results — no icon grid required.
bullets: Global search across apps, contacts, calendar, Wikipedia, and your own Nextcloud
Built from scratch — not an AOSP launcher reskin — with buttery gesture animations
Widget-heavy home with clock, weather, music, notes, and calendar at a glance
Bonus tools in the search bar: calculator, unit conversion, and timers
benefits: Open your phone and type two letters — the app you want is already there
Replaces grid-hunting with one gesture and the keyboard you already know
Searches your own cloud too, so files and events surface alongside apps
Lightweight and fast: no launcher bloat, no ad-loaded icon folders
setupSteps: Install Kvaesitso from F-Droid or the project's GitHub releases
Set it as your default home app when prompted
Grant notification and accessibility access for badges and gestures
Swipe down anywhere to search — add widgets or plugins like weather afterward
details: Kvaesitso is an Android launcher built from scratch rather than on top of the AOSP launcher, and its organizing principle is search instead of an icon grid. A swipe-down gesture opens a global search bar that matches apps, contacts, and calendar events on-device, plus web services like Wikipedia or your own Nextcloud instance — with calculator, unit conversion, and timer results mixed right in, so "600 x 12" or "30 min" answers before you finish typing. The home screen leans on widgets (clock, weather, music, notes, calendar) with Material You theming, and plugins let you swap providers, such as the weather source. Notification access powers unread badges and the accessibility service enables the gestures. The result is simple: you navigate your phone by typing the first letters of what you want, which is consistently faster than hunting through pages of icons.
